points.title: 爱尔兰成长
points.description: 乔伊斯在都柏林度过了他的童年和青年时期，接受耶稣会教育，在都柏林大学学院学习现代语言。这一时期他开始创作短篇小说和诗歌，并逐渐对爱尔兰天主教文化和民族主义产生疏离感。1904年，他遇到了后来的妻子诺拉·巴纳克尔，两人决定离开爱尔兰，这标志着乔伊斯与故土的决裂。都柏林成为他文学创作的重要背景，尤其是《都柏林人》和《尤利西斯》中的城市描绘。
points.descriptionEn: Joyce spent his childhood and youth in Dublin, receiving Jesuit education and studying modern languages at University College Dublin. During this period, he began writing short stories and poems, and gradually developed alienation from Irish Catholic culture and nationalism. In 1904, he met his future wife Nora Barnacle, and they decided to leave Ireland, marking Joyce's break from his homeland. Dublin became a crucial backdrop for his literary works, particularly in the descriptions of the city in 'Dubliners' and 'Ulysses'.

points.title: 欧洲流亡
points.description: 乔伊斯与诺拉移居的里雅斯特，开始了长达数十年的流亡生活。在这里，他教授英语，同时进行文学创作。1907年，他的散文集《室内乐》出版。1914年，短篇小说集《都柏林人》历经多年波折终于出版。这一时期乔伊斯开始构思《一个青年艺术家的肖像》，并在1916年出版。的里雅斯特时期是乔伊斯文学风格形成的关键阶段，他逐渐发展出意识流技巧，同时受到欧洲现代主义思潮的深刻影响。
points.descriptionEn: Joyce and Nora moved to Trieste, beginning decades of exile. Here, he taught English while pursuing his literary career. In 1907, his collection of poems 'Chamber Music' was published. After years of difficulties, his short story collection 'Dubliners' was finally published in 1914. During this period, Joyce began working on 'A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man,' published in 1916. The Trieste years were crucial for the development of Joyce's literary style, as he gradually developed stream of consciousness techniques while being deeply influenced by European modernist thought.

points.title: 战时创作
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，乔伊斯移居瑞士苏黎世。尽管面临经济困难和健康问题，他在这段时期完成了《一个青年艺术家的肖像》的出版，并开始创作《尤利西斯》的大部分内容。1918年，他在苏黎世结识了现代主义诗人艾兹拉·庞德，后者成为他重要的支持者和推广者。苏黎世时期是乔伊斯创作生涯的关键转折点，他在这座城市完成了从传统叙事到现代主义实验的转变，为《尤利西斯》的出版奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War I, Joyce moved to Zurich, Switzerland. Despite facing financial difficulties and health problems, he published 'A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man' and began writing most of 'Ulysses' during this period. In 1918, he met the modernist poet Ezra Pound in Zurich, who became an important supporter and promoter of his work. The Zurich years marked a crucial turning point in Joyce's career, where he completed his transition from traditional narrative to modernist experimentation, laying the foundation for the publication of 'Ulysses'.

points.title: 文学巅峰
points.description: 1920年，乔伊斯移居巴黎，这是他创作生涯的巅峰时期。1922年，他的代表作《尤利西斯》在巴黎出版，这部作品被誉为20世纪最重要的小说之一，彻底改变了现代小说的面貌。在巴黎，乔伊斯与众多现代主义作家和艺术家交往，包括塞缪尔·贝克特、庞德和毕加索等。1928年，他开始创作最后一部长篇小说《芬尼根的守灵夜》，这部作品以其极端的语言实验和复杂性著称。巴黎时期也是乔伊斯视力急剧恶化的时期，他几乎完全失明，但仍坚持创作。
points.descriptionEn: In 1920, Joyce moved to Paris, marking the peak of his literary career. In 1922, his masterpiece 'Ulysses' was published in Paris, widely regarded as one of the most important novels of the 20th century, revolutionizing the modern novel. In Paris, Joyce associated with many modernist writers and artists, including Samuel Beckett, Ezra Pound, and Pablo Picasso. In 1928, he began working on his final novel 'Finnegans Wake,' known for its extreme linguistic experimentation and complexity. The Paris years were also marked by rapidly deteriorating eyesight, as Joyce became almost completely blind but continued to write.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 1940年，随着纳粹占领法国，乔伊斯被迫离开巴黎，回到瑞士苏黎世。尽管健康状况持续恶化，他仍在继续修改《芬尼根的守灵夜》。1941年1月10日，乔伊斯因腹部手术并发症在苏黎世去世，享年59岁。他的葬礼在苏黎世举行，遗体后被安葬在弗伦特恩公墓。乔伊斯的去世标志着现代主义文学一个重要时代的结束，他的作品对后世文学产生了深远影响，尤其是意识流技巧和语言实验方面。
points.descriptionEn: In 1940, as Nazi forces occupied France, Joyce was forced to leave Paris and returned to Zurich. Despite his deteriorating health, he continued to revise 'Finnegans Wake.' On January 10, 1941, Joyce died of complications following abdominal surgery in Zurich at the age of 59. His funeral was held in Zurich, and his remains were later buried in the Fluntern Cemetery. Joyce's death marked the end of an important era in modernist literature, and his works have had a profound influence on subsequent literature, particularly in stream of consciousness techniques and linguistic experimentation.

appraisal.zh: 乔伊斯被普遍视为现代主义文学的先驱，他以意识流与语言实验革新了小说艺术，《尤利西斯》与《芬尼根的守灵夜》被奉为现代文学的高峰，对细节的执着与对语言边界的突破为后世作家开辟了新路。另一种看法认为，他的实验晦涩难解、近于自我放纵，形式探索之下内容空洞，对爱尔兰传统的批判失之片面，作品中的精英气息与疏离大众也受到质疑，其家庭关系与对赞助人的依赖同样引起议论。
appraisal.en: Joyce is generally regarded as a pioneer of modernist literature who transformed the novel through stream of consciousness and linguistic experiment; 'Ulysses' and 'Finnegans Wake' stand as landmarks, and his obsession with detail and pushing of linguistic boundaries opened new paths for later writers. Another view holds that his experiments are obscure and self-indulgent, formally brilliant but empty, his critique of Irish tradition one-sided, and his elitism and distance from popular culture questionable, while his family relations and reliance on patrons have also drawn comment.

supporter.zh: 乔伊斯是现代主义文学的先驱和巨匠，他通过意识流技巧和语言实验彻底革新了小说艺术。《尤利西斯》和《芬尼根的守灵夜》代表了文学创作的最高成就，展现了人类意识的无限可能。乔伊斯对细节的极致追求和对语言边界的不断突破，为后世作家开辟了新的创作路径。他的作品不仅是对爱尔兰文化的深刻反思，更是对人类普遍经验的探索，具有永恒的艺术价值。
supporter.en: Joyce is a pioneer and giant of modernist literature who revolutionized the art of the novel through stream of consciousness techniques and linguistic experimentation. 'Ulysses' and 'Finnegans Wake' represent the highest achievements in literary creation, showcasing the infinite possibilities of human consciousness. Joyce's relentless pursuit of detail and constant pushing of linguistic boundaries have opened new paths for subsequent writers. His works are not only profound reflections on Irish culture but explorations of universal human experience, possessing eternal artistic value.

critic.zh: 乔伊斯的实验性写作常被批评为晦涩难懂、自我放纵，脱离普通读者的理解能力。《尤利西斯》和《芬尼根的守灵夜》的极端语言实验被视为形式主义的表现，内容空洞。一些批评者认为乔伊斯对爱尔兰传统的批判过于片面，忽视了爱尔兰文化的积极面。此外，他作品中流露出的精英主义倾向和对大众文化的疏离也受到质疑。他的个人生活，包括与家庭的关系和经济上对赞助人的依赖，也成为争议点。
critic.en: Joyce's experimental writing is often criticized as obscure, self-indulgent, and inaccessible to ordinary readers. The extreme linguistic experimentation in 'Ulysses' and 'Finnegans Wake' is seen as formalist with empty content. Some critics argue that Joyce's critique of Irish tradition is one-sided, neglecting the positive aspects of Irish culture. Additionally, the elitist tendencies in his work and alienation from popular culture have been questioned. His personal life, including relationships with family and financial dependence on patrons, has also been controversial.

objective.zh: 在历史学和流行文化中，乔伊斯被定义为现代主义文学的核心人物和文化符号。他的作品不仅是文学史上的里程碑，也成为文化研究的重要对象。乔伊斯的生平，尤其是与爱尔兰的复杂关系，被广泛讨论为文化身份和流亡主题的典型案例。在流行文化中，乔伊斯形象常与知识分子、叛逆者和艺术先锋联系在一起，'布卢姆日'的全球庆祝活动体现了其文化影响力。他的作品被不断重新解读，反映了不同时代对现代主义理解的演变。
objective.en: In historical and popular culture contexts, Joyce is defined as a central figure of modernist literature and a cultural symbol. His works are not only milestones in literary history but also important subjects for cultural studies. Joyce's life, particularly his complex relationship with Ireland, is widely discussed as a典型案例 of cultural identity and exile themes. In popular culture, Joyce is often associated with intellectuals, rebels, and artistic pioneers. The global celebration of 'Bloomsday' reflects his cultural influence. His works continue to be reinterpreted, reflecting the evolution of modernist understanding across different eras.

self.zh: 人生太短，我要用爱尔兰的语言写一部永恒的书。
self.en: Life is too short to write anything but masterpieces.
